Qwen3.827B and Muse Glimmer (30B) are both openweight reasoning models designed to fit on a single 24GB consumer GPU (such as an RTX 4090 or 5090) . Qwen3.827B leads across most reasoning, coding, and computeruse benchmarks, whereas Muse Glimmer offers faster timetofirsttoken, lower API serving costs, and strong deepreasoning accuracy .



 Core Specifications

| Feature / Metric | Alibaba Qwen3.827B | Meta Muse Glimmer |
| : | : | : |
| Developer | Alibaba Cloud  | Meta  |
| Active Parameters | ~27.8B  | ~30B  |
| Native Context Window | 256k / 262k tokens  | 131k tokens  |
| License | Apache 2.0  | Apache 2.0  |
| Multimodal Support | Yes (Vision/Text)  | Yes (Vision/Text)  |
| SWEBench Pro | 61.7%  | 51.2%–53.4%  |
| TerminalBench 2.1 | 73.0%  | 51.7%  |
| GPQA Diamond | 89.2%  | 83.5%  |
| OSWorldVerified | 84.3%  | 65.9%  |
| TimetoFirstToken (TTFT) | ~2.98 s  | ~0.80 s  |
| API Cost (per M tokens) | ~$0.43  | ~$0.23  |



 Key Strengths of Qwen3.827B

 Agentic coding and terminal work: It substantially outperforms Muse Glimmer on software engineering benchmarks (SWEBench Pro, TerminalBench, and OSWorld) .
 Longcontext capabilities: With a native 256k context window, it achieves higher retrieval recall across large document repositories without dropping needle data .
 General problemsolving: It holds a consistent edge in highdifficulty academic benchmarks such as GPQA Diamond and Humanity's Last Exam .



 Key Strengths of Muse Glimmer

 Inference latency and responsiveness: Muse Glimmer demonstrates a significantly faster timetofirsttoken and higher raw generation throughput in standard decoding setups .
 Deep search accuracy: On small suites of complex constraint puzzles, its extended reasoning budget allows it to resolve edge cases effectively .
 Cost efficiency: For API users, Muse Glimmer's blended token pricing is nearly half the cost of Qwen3.827B .



 Recommendation

 Choose Qwen3.827B if your primary use cases are autonomous coding, toolcalling agents, terminal automation, or longcontext document analysis .
 Choose Muse Glimmer if you need lower inference latency, cheaper hosted API costs, or lighter memory overhead for interactive chat workflows .
